text.p: ROME, Sept 12 (Reuter) Following are some of the top headlines in Italy's leading newspapers.
*Three days before separatist Northern league declares a self-styled independent state of "Padania", prime minister Romano Prodi warns the league that Italy must not be divided like Yugoslavia.(ALL)
*Industry board Confindustria says the 1997 Italian budget which intends to lower the national debt, does not go far enough to avoid another recession. (ALL)
*Minister of finance Vincenzo Visco says that income tax will be lowered.(ALL)
*High tech giant Olivetti breathes easier as shares recover by 1.8 percentage points on the Italian stock market.(Stampa, Corriere)
*Chairman of state owned telecommunications company Stet, Michele Tedeschi, has 80 days to implement the government's privatization plans. (il sole)
- Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy. Rome bureau:++39 6 678 2501
